# Draft 1 (FINAL) — Agent C humanized

MCP tak lagi sekadar "sambungkan agent ke tools".

Minggu ni Anthropic buka Skills over MCP dalam public beta (24 Nov 2026): server kini boleh ship playbook sekali sekali dengan tools, dan Claude load bila perlu je. Shopify, GitHub, Supabase dah antara yang start.

Skala ekosistem sekarang: registry rasmi MCP dah ada 72,684 unique servers setakat 24 Nov, naik 46% sebulan. HostedMCP pula jejak 52,147 agent skills dari 3,339 repo GitHub (data 14 Nov). SDK MCP sendiri dah lepasi 700M downloads sebulan.

Skill = cara agent guna tool dengan betul. Sekarang ia boleh diedarkan, bukan di-copy-paste.

#AIAgents #MCP

items.title: Draft 2 (FINAL) — Agent C humanized
items.text:
# Draft 2 (FINAL) — Agent C humanized

1.7 juta install. Itu jumlah yang dicapai satu kempen malware lewat AI skills — bukan apps, skills.

Zenity Labs dedah pada Ogos 2026: skills palsu di skills.sh (typosquat nama Paperclip & Browser Use) kumpul 1.7M+ installs antara 11 Julai–2 Ogos sebelum dimusnahkan. Skills tu arahkan agent pasang credential stealer dari GitHub: SSH keys, cloud credentials, sampai fail .env.

Dan skala ancaman ni lebih besar dari satu kempen. Scan HostedMCP 14 Nov: 118,434 MCP servers aktif dikesan, tapi sekitar 1.2% ada high-severity finding, 669 skills bagi akses shell tanpa approval, dan 16 skills pula ada script hantar credentials keluar. Anthropic pun bertindak: sejak awal Nov, plugin directory terima command hooks & local MCP servers hanya dari Verified organizations (issue #7024).

Rule saya: sebelum pasang apa-apa skill, tengok publisher dan permissions. Agent read-only tak perlu write access.

#AgentSecurity

items.title: Draft 3 (FINAL) — Agent C humanized
items.text:
# Draft 3 (FINAL) — Agent C humanized

Kita semua fikir: lebih ramai agent, lebih bagus. Kajian Anthropic kata sebaliknya.

"Worse Together" (11 Nov 2026, arXiv:2610.00583) uji lima model frontier dalam 77 scenarios, 4 environment. Satu coordinator agent yang khidmat semua orang beat peer-to-peer team dalam setiap satu — jurang 10–45 percentage points. Bila team grow 4→16 agents, yang benar-benar bertindak jatuh dari 66% ke 10%. Dan dalam 65–77% episodes, ada agent override arahan orang lain.

Bukan teori makmal sahaja. Thread r/LangChain tanya "do you actually trust your AI agent when it says done?" — jawapannya ramai yang kata tak, sebab agent kata done tapi anda baru tahu kemudian.

Multi-agent bukan magic. Kadang satu agent yang jelas arah lagi bagus dari sepuluh yang saling override.

#MultiAgent

Use-Case Research Notes — 2026-11-24 (Selasa)

Apa berlaku

  • Tarikh/jam: 2026-11-24 15:02 +08. Cron harian Boss.
  • Engine last30days v3.26.0 dijalankan (exit 0) ke atas topik "Hermes Agent viral use cases workflows November 2026" dengan --plan (LAW 7, plan JSON sendiri ke tmpfile), --emit=compact, flags: --subreddits=AI_Agents,LocalLLaMA,singularity,ChatGPTCoding,selfhosted,artificial, --github-repo=nousresearch/hermes-agent, --save-dir=$HOME/.hermes/cache/scratch/last30days-usecases.
  • Plan subqueries: primary (Hermes Agent use cases), builds (mini-apps/demos), automation (cron/TG bot/watchers), viral_agents (Nov 2026 viral agent use cases incl. Polymarket).

Partial coverage (honest)

  • Sumber aktif: Reddit (13 threads, 16 upvotes — thin), HN (25 stories, 1,475 pts), GitHub (11 items), Polymarket (4 markets). X/Twitter dan YouTube TIDAK diaktifkan (engine: "Optional source omitted: X/Twitter was not enabled") — jadi tiada bukti X/YouTube terus; semua tuntutan viral di bawah disokong web_search ber-sumber.
  • Reddit rendah skor; HN kaya dengan berita infra/sekuriti (United Airlines ban agent booking 684pts HN#50458900; npm backdoor hermes-agent safedep 2026-11-21; Maritime launch 60pts).

Sumber web (Step 2 supplements, semua ada URL)

  1. agentusecases.ai — 2,328 use cases (updated Nov 23, 2026); Hermes Agent page: 58 contoh (updated Nov 19). Contoh relevan: flight check-in + chase Student Finance refund + dispute parking warning + delivery evidence + unsubscribe + file prescription ke Paperless; price drops + calls via Twilio/Vapi + email drafts (send only after human Send); log meals dari teks/foto ke calorie tracker + itinerari dari forwarded confirmations (tangkap train salah hari); penyata bank → spreadsheet dikategorikan mengikut payee (Hermes); 24/7 local agent Proxmox+Qwen, RSS digest ke Telegram tanpa kos API. Nov 23 new: "Watch refundable ticket prices and claim the drop" (saved $250, 30-day deadline); "Explain a denied insurance claim from EOB and policy"; "Audit vendor dashboard paths and correct stale docs" (Claude in Chrome, 106 paths read-only Stripe/Cloudflare/Supabase/GitHub, 8 drift); "Negotiate retention discounts by phone"; "Diagnose and clean up a slow Windows PC"; "Order a pizza" (gagal — bukan viral-success).
  2. HN Ask 50385157 "How do AI agents help you in your daily life?" (Nov 5, gonzar79, 9 comments) — comments: budget auto-categorize dari transaksi; meal ideas → recipe → online grocery order; dictate Home Depot list + in-store map; judo journal dictation → Notion template + review notes; Linux paperwork organization.
  3. ZDNET Nov 4, 2026 — "6 AI agent workflows I use to hand off everyday tasks": scrape+filter posts, travel 7-day forecast + localized weather + packing list.
  4. The Third Shift substack Nov 19, 2026 — "You Can Pry My AI Agent From My Cold, Dead Hands": Instinct agent via text/email, "two-minute rule", delegate not just ask (IP attorney follow-up, marble repair options, furniture layout).
  5. Product Peak substack Nov 18, 2026 — "Grok Bot Is Claude Code for Everyone Else": 8 named agents team; meal-planning bot runs Friday routine, cross-checks training bot, fills grocery cart after user OK.
  6. AIsa Studio (Reddit r/AI_Agents Nov 14) — "What I'm doing with my AI Agents as a normal person": 8 agents — Hunter (deals), Drew (RV locations at work), Darrow (projects), Email Bob (inbox), Budget Steve (bank account, spotted duplicate health insurance), Homey Herman (household reminders), Siri 2.0 bot.
  7. Reddit r/AI_Agents "What would your ideal AI agent do day to day?" — landlord follow-up system: list yes/no/"waiting since Tuesday", never spend without approval.
  8. hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-stories — grandfather safety system (HA+Zigbee+panic buttons), NetBox nightly network discovery, real estate agent accounting ($18k/yr saved), multi-role agent (nutritionist/dev/finance), HA add-on.
  9. awesome-openclaw-agents USE-CASES.md (GitHub, Feb 2026) — #80 Auto Flight Check-in (next flight, window seat), flight price tracking, weekly personal finance summary, smart home, Polymarket bot.
  10. assistantbenchmark.com/use-cases (updated Nov 19, 2026) — morning briefing with replies already drafted; cut a bill/switch provider; morning news+repo brief on Telegram; book flight with points.
  11. CNN Nov 4, 2026 callout — agents for daily life (budget, calendar, recipes, grocery, social plans).
  12. sphereinc.com "100 OpenClaw Use Cases (2026)" — weekly personal finance summary from bank export; home systems maintenance calendar (HVAC/water heater/filters → reminders + how-to + local providers); smart home voice via Telegram.
  13. latenode.com — plain-text accounting (hledger): agent runs queries "how much did I spend on X"; health API daily summaries.

Anti-repeat check vs history.json (2026-11-05 → 2026-11-23)

Semua tajuk lepas dibaca; 5 pilihan hari ini TIADA padanan semantik:

  1. Money-back/refund hunter — vs 11-16 (FNOL motor claim sahaja), 11-09 (pengesan caj berulang), 11-07 (retention bill) — bezanya: pemulihan wang (price-drop refund, window pembatalan, saman/PDRM, EOB insurans, refund institusi).
  2. Maintenance calendar rumah/kenderaan — vs 11-11 (expiry dokumen peribadi: passport/lesen/insurans/waranti) — bezanya: servis berkala berasaskan tarikh/mileage + sebut harga bengkel.
  3. Travel post-booking autopilot (check-in + seat + price-drop refund) — vs 11-23 (reservation keeper: log+reminder sahaja) dan 11-07 (concierge pra-tempahan).
  4. Vendor dashboard drift audit — vs 11-16 (cron truth-auditor: artifact dalaman) dan 11-05 (sysadmin watchdog: port/disk dalaman) — bezanya: UI luaran (registrar/hosting/dashboard) read-only.
  5. Auto-bookkeeping peribadi (kategorikan penyata + ringkasan mingguan + anomali) — vs 11-09 (caj berulang sahaja), 11-12 (resit relief cukai), 11-14 (kos token LLM), 11-20 (bil TNB sahaja).

5 use case terpilih (disokong sumber di atas)

  1. Pemburu refund & tuntutan (money-back agent) — agentusecases.ai Nov 23 (refundable ticket price drop, saved $250; denied EOB; Student Finance refund chase; parking warning dispute).
  2. Kalendar penyenggaraan rumah & kenderaan — sphereinc 100 use cases (home systems maintenance calendar), HN#50385157 comment (budget/list), user-stories.
  3. Autopilot pasca-tempahan travel — awesome-openclaw #80 auto check-in + window seat; agentusecases.ai Hermes flight check-in; HN#50458900 United ban (684pts) → framing: booking dengan agent dilarang, jadi check-in/logistik sahaja dengan approve.
  4. Audit drift dashboard vendor — agentusecases.ai Nov 23 (106 paths read-only, 8 drift corrected).
  5. Auto-bookkeeping peribadi — sphereinc weekly finance summary; latenode hledger queries; AIsa Budget Steve (duplicate insurance spotted via bank); HN#50385157 budget comment; agentusecases.ai Hermes bank statements → categorized spreadsheet.

Tindakan

  • history.json di-append dengan 5 tajuk (date 2026-11-24).
  • Tiada perubahan sistem dibuat; semua cadangan binaan perlu "Approve" Boss bertulis.
